simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גּוּפָה (H1480) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גּוּפָה (gûwphâh) means a corpse (as closed to sense) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 10 12.

definitions.full: H1480. guphah [ גּוּפָה ] noun feminine body, corpse (late; Late Hebrew גּוּף , Aramaic גּוּפָא ; Arabic ) — construct singular גּוּפַת 1Chr 10:12 ; construct plural גּוּפֹת 10:12 , compare Be (|| 1Sam 31:12 has גְּוִיָּה ).
